summary: The packet has a solid core: Anthropic's official agent-sandboxing post, official Claude project examples, a practitioner comparison of Codex/Claude Code/Cursor, Stanford HAI scaling-law research, VibeMotion's open-source Figma-to-video release, Co-Invest's ChatGPT/Claude trading launch, David Sacks on AI deregulation, and a Demis Hassabis interview. Weaknesses are several secondary or low-engagement open-source/tool claims, one mismatched selection_reason for whichllm, and some promotional framing. Replace or search around the weakest secondary items rather than expanding stale prior-day stories.
